heading: Two ideas, almost level. Decide between them on Friday.
text: Netting House and Fire Drill are the only ideas all three agents picked, and they finish almost level. Everything below them is a clear step down, so stop debating the rest of the pool. Read the tracks at the opening, then choose one of these two within the first hour.

heading: Build Fire Drill if the big tracks are Anthropic, security, Cartesia or Hyphenate
text: Build it from two pivots the agents scored separately. The Skeptic's engine is a deterministic policy at the tool boundary that blocks any payment whose bank details came from untrusted text. That engine triggers the callback the Impact Analyst and the Venture Scout each proposed on their own: a separate voice agent phones the vendor on the number of record before money moves. The merge answers every lens: an engine of your own (A), the fraud human AP desks lose money to today (B), and use on every payment rather than a monthly drill (C). Drop the 'KnowBe4 for AI agents' line, because KnowBe4 now ships Agent Risk Manager. Don't call it Proving Ground either: that is the name of Gray Swan's weekly arena.

heading: Build Netting House if the big tracks are Fetch.ai, Hyphenate or fintech (Visa, Coinbase, CRS)
text: It is the only idea all three agents picked as written, and the Skeptic calls it the most real system in the pool: a solver, invariants and a commit protocol move the money. All three agents named the same risk, cold start: one firm alone saves nothing and the demo economy is synthetic. Put real set-off evidence on screen (Slovenia's national netting, Cycles), credit Cycles, and name Causa Prima, which raised a pre-seed for agent-to-agent B2B payments.

heading: Keep Two-Face as the backup, not the plan
text: All three agents picked a version of Two-Face, but each picked a different one: a render-parity firewall (twice) and a merchant check sold to agent-card issuers. None of those versions beats either leader. If you end up here, build the firewall, because the Skeptic and the Impact Analyst both back it. The Venture Scout's warning is that it is a feature, not a company.

heading: What to stop discussing
text: Every glasses and Trainium idea, Jailbreak Booth, Save States, Cal Hacks Futures and The Pit sit at the bottom on every lens. So do Close Raid, Backlog Tower Defense and Zero-Trust Base Defense, which the earlier judge audit had moved up. Vault Heist lost its novelty case: Tensor Trust is already a multiplayer vault game, and Gray Swan opened an agent-hacking arena with Anthropic as a sponsor this week.
